reviewer: Codex agent; editorial review of every final output; model identities visible; not human feedback

rubric.fidelity: 5 preserves material facts, actions and requests; 4 minor added framing/omission; 3 ambiguity or nonessential unsupported context; 2 material omission/action reversal; 1 opposite action with direct risk.
rubric.grammar: 5 correct; 4 minor punctuation/register issue; 3 noticeable grammatical error; 2 multiple serious errors; 1 unusable.
rubric.tone_clarity: 5 matches requested tone clearly; 4 mild verbosity/formality; 3 appreciable mismatch/ambiguity; 2 disruptive; 1 unusable.
rubric.note: Literal fact checking, placeholders and name corrections are scored separately. Semantically equivalent date reformatting can receive good semantic fidelity yet fail strict literal preservation. Critical errors include altered prohibitions, unsupported attachments/actions and material omitted conditions. Scores are agent judgments, not calibrated human labels.
